commands.name: worktree-create
commands.summary: Create (or converge) a git worktree with dependencies materialized and agent state bootstrapped
commands.description: Creates a worktree at the family convention path (../.worktrees/<repo>/<branch>), materializes dependencies (rush install, sharing the source checkout's pnpm store and build cache), and seeds agent state (Claude trust/permissions/MCP approvals, .claude/settings.local.json) so the first session in the worktree starts with zero interactive prompts. Re-running against an existing same-branch worktree converges it (repairs/completes the bootstrap) instead of refusing. Reports per-stage timings. Rush global commands take no positional arguments, so the branch is passed via --branch (standalone `worktree-rush create <branch>` accepts a positional). This plugin must be installed in an autoinstaller named "rush-plugins".

commands.name: worktree-remove
commands.summary: Remove a worktree created by worktree-create, including its seeded agent state
commands.description: The symmetric inverse of worktree-create: performs a read-only dirty-tree and merge-proof preflight, removes the worktree at the family convention path, deletes the authorized branch, prunes the seeded ~/.claude.json project entry, and runs `git worktree prune`. --merged-into accepts ancestry or exact tree equivalence for squash merges; --force bypasses proof and is mutually exclusive with it. Already-absent worktrees/branches are success, not errors. Rush global commands take no positional arguments, so the branch is passed via --branch (standalone `worktree-rush remove <branch>` accepts a positional).

parameters.description: Branch name for the worktree. Required.
Source checkout to inherit state from (create) or that the worktree belongs to (remove). Default: the repo the command runs in.
Filtered install: forwarded to `rush install --to <PROJECT>` (repeatable). The checkout stays full; only dependency materialization narrows.
Resolve this local ref and use its commit only when creating a new local branch. Existing branches/worktrees are never moved, and no fetch is performed.
Skip dependency materialization (git worktree + state bootstrap only).
Skip the agent-state bootstrap (trust/permissions/MCP seeding and settings.local.json copy).
Do not link the source checkout's pnpm store and build cache into the worktree before installing.
Remove a dirty worktree / delete an unmerged branch (git's own --force semantics).
Resolve this local commit and prove ancestry or exact tree equivalence before removal. No fetch or remote inference is performed; mutually exclusive with --force.
Print the stage-timing report as JSON on stdout.
